mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND (status='SHIPPED' OR (status='COMPLETED' AND completed_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)-INTERVAL 7 DAY))
SELECT CAST(order_item_id AS CHAR) order_item_id,unit_no,amount_cents FROM refund_allocation WHERE source_no=#{sourceNo} ORDER BY order_item_id,unit_no

SELECT CAST(a.order_item_id AS CHAR) order_item_id,a.unit_no,CAST(i.sku_id AS CHAR) sku_id FROM refund_allocation a JOIN order_item i ON i.id=a.order_item_id WHERE a.source_no=#{sourceNo} ORDER BY a.order_item_id,a.unit_no
SELECT CAST(order_item_id AS CHAR) order_item_id,unit_no,disposition FROM order_return_disposition WHERE source_no=#{sourceNo} ORDER BY order_item_id,unit_no
mapper.update: UPDATE order_item_unit SET return_state='RECEIVED',version=version+1 WHERE active_aftersale_no=#{sourceNo} AND return_state='RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM return_stock_task WHERE (state='READY' AND next_retry_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (state='RUNNING' AND lease_until<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT * FROM return_stock_task WHERE source_no=#{sourceNo} AND state='RUNNING' AND claim_version=#{claimVersion} AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_authorization a SET a.state='COMPLETED' WHERE a.source_no=#{sourceNo} AND a.state='SETTLING' AND (a.source_type='REFUND_ONLY' OR (a.source_type='RETURN_REFUND' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_return_receipt r WHERE r.source_no=a.source_no AND r.status='APPLIED')))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM return_stock_task ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE return_stock_task SET state='READY',attempt_count=0,claim_version=claim_version+1,lease_until=NULL,next_retry_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),last_error=NULL WHERE source_no=#{sourceNo} AND state='MANUAL_REVIEW'
